operating_notes.text: Board recommended final dividend of ₹0.70 per share for FY25-26 and appointed Mr. N. P. Gupta as CEO effective July 1, 2026.
Board recommended annual dividend of ₹0.70 per share for FY25-26.
EKC Egypt S.A.E. commenced dispatches of CNG cylinders, becoming the first local manufacturing unit for CNG cylinders in Egypt and Africa.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹358.2 Cr (-15.1% YoY), net profit ₹45.7 Cr (+244.4% YoY).
Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.70 per share (35%) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.

Suman Khurana, Pushkar Khurana, Puneet Khurana, Nishita Khurana, Pooja Khurana, Varun Khurana, Sonia Khurana, Khurana Gases Pvt Ltd, Medical Engineers (India) Limited, Pushkar Family Trust declared no share encumbrances in FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Everest Kanto Cylinder reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹358.2 Cr and net profit of ₹45.7 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹0.70 per share.
Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited shared the Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call audio recording on June 3, 2026, via its website.
Everest Kanto Cylinder's subsidiary EKC Egypt S.A.E. commenced dispatches of CNG cylinders from its manufacturing unit in Egypt.
